verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships a browser-based visual Editor with viewport, real-time multi-user scene building, live editing of materials/positions/scripts, and checkpoint/version snapshots, positioning it as a primary way to build levels without code (playcanvas-docs-24, -25, -4, -13, -26, -5). Community mentions confirm it as a genuine 'scene editor' used for real projects (playcanvas-comm-14, playcanvas-comm-11). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a prefab/template system and an inspector panel by name, plus independent hands-on reviews specifically praising the editor's usability for technical artists (as opposed to complaints about offline/local workflows, which are a separate axis).
